primary_recommendation.selection_basis: Highest target score WITHIN the Pareto frontier (ties broken by the route/round/experiment/candidate composite key ascending, because candidate_id repeats across rounds). No frontier member was removed by this choice.
primary_recommendation.cross_route_comparability_disclaimer: Cross-route target-score ordering is INDICATIVE ONLY. Each route normalizes its soft score against its own executable objective contract; the normalized values are not directly comparable between routes (red line 6). This ranking is used solely to pick the primary recommendation INSIDE the Pareto frontier -- it never removes any solution from the frontier, and every frontier member remains part of the delivered portfolio.

design_orientation.scientific_hypothesis: Constraining a validated thin layer (~29 nm) to a narrow bound [26, 32] nm while allowing ±15% perturbation on adjacent layers will improve target score by mapping local optimum curvature without destabilizing the global stack performance.

design_orientation.scientific_hypothesis: Locking the central cavity spacer at 145 nm (preserving the 255-280 nm resonance node from Round 2 peak) while constraining peripheral layer perturbations to ±2 nm will stabilize the passband transmission and allow the optimizer to fine-tune out-of-band blocking without disturbing the verified resonance condition.
design_orientation.proposed_topology: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2(cavity, fixed 145nm) | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | Fused Silica substrate. Total 21 finite layers with layer 3 (0-indexed) or layer 4 (1-indexed) as the cavity spacer fixed at 145 nm.

design_orientation.scientific_hypothesis: Applying controlled stochastic perturbation to high-thickness anchor layers (indices 3, 15, 17) will shift the cavity resonance off the saturated operating point, enabling the gradient optimizer to discover adjacent Fabry-Pérot order configurations that deterministic initialization missed, potentially improving target score beyond the 0.5178 plateau.

design_orientation.scientific_hypothesis: Score regression resulted from overly restrictive thickness perturbation bounds that trapped optimization in a local minimum. Expanding bounds to ±15% on layers 1, 2, 7, 9 and implementing hybrid initialization (elite retention plus broad stochastic seeding) will restore search flexibility and improve target score.
design_orientation.proposed_topology: 11-layer fixed sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2 on fused silica substrate, air incidence

design_orientation.scientific_hypothesis: Fine-scale spectral ripples in the 255-280 nm passband are dominated by phase errors in the central cavity spacer layers (10-13). Localized Gaussian perturbations scaled to ±1.5 nm with 50% reduced optimizer step-size will resolve these ripples without destabilizing the broader stopband architecture, yielding incremental target score improvement beyond 0.5216.

design_orientation.scientific_hypothesis: Initializing optimization from the iteration_16 second candidate thickness configuration [21.36, 66.22, 44.85, 121.12, 46.71, 23.87, 17.77, 48.79, 27.57, 107.85, 46.87, 27.01, 32.56, 54.29, 77.79, 16.29] nm with tightened ±20% robustness bounds will exploit restored phase-matching conditions and yield higher target scores than the ±25% baseline while maintaining manufacturability.
